metadata.title: my-agents
metadata.description: Frontend console for the my-agents FastAPI + LangGraph service

home.eyebrow: AI product console with run evidence
home.title: A console for transcripts, evidence, and source-aware conversations.
home.description: From one authenticated workspace, inspect transcript flows, stream activity events, validate citations, and trace every answer to its source documents.
featureCards: Transcript-first workflow: user turns and assistant responses remain linked per conversation.
Activity timeline for run lifecycle events, queued follow-ups, and stop operations.
Citation-backed cards make provenance explicit for each knowledge-assisted response.
transcriptRows: user: Can you summarize today’s conversation highlights?
agent: Captured 3 evidence snippets from the knowledge index.
system: Citation batch attached; document source: docs/onboarding.md
activityItems: Run started: assistant invoked with knowledge tools
Citation attached from document source: kb/onboarding.md
Queued follow-up accepted after current answer
home.citationText: Every visible answer includes source-backed references before rendering in the chat pane.
home.sourceText: Primary artifacts: PDF, Markdown, and plain-text sources captured with chunk metadata.

auth.heroDescription: Authenticate with the backend, then inspect transcript turns, activity events, citations, and document-source evidence in one console flow.
features: Keep conversation transcripts linked to citation-backed agent activity.
Track live run lifecycle and queued follow-ups from the same shell.
Open document-source evidence from each assistant response.
auth.signupDescription: Create an account, then log in with the same credentials.
auth.loginDescription: Use the backend auth session to enter the console.
auth.signupSuccessDescription: We created {email}. You can now log in with this account.
auth.guestDescription: Continue with a 24-hour guest session: one chat, up to 5 prompts, and up to 3 document uploads. The backend enforces these limits.

service.sessionRestored: Backend session restored through /auth/me; chat, documents, knowledge, and group actions stay server-owned.
sessionEvidenceItems: Conversation runs expose status, activity events, and citations.
Documents keep source metadata visible for upload and ingest checks.
ID-based group workflows remain explicit until backend search exists.

chat.title: Chat
chat.deleteConversationConfirm: Delete "{title}"? This removes the conversation and all messages. This cannot be undone.
chat.deleteConversationActiveRunDisabled: Stop the active answer before deleting this conversation.
chat.noActiveConversationDescription: Create a conversation to unlock the chat composer.
chat.streamingComposerPlaceholder: Type a follow-up — Enter queues it after this answer.
chat.queuedComposerPlaceholder: Edit or cancel the queued message before adding another follow-up.
chat.sendNowHelper: Enter queues your follow-up. Send now stops the current answer first, then sends this message.
chat.sendNowWaitingForRun: Waiting for the backend run id before this answer can be stopped.
chat.sendNowQueuedBlocked: Edit or cancel the queued message before sending a different message now.
chat.queuedHelper: Will send after the current answer finishes.
chat.queuedAfterFailureHelper: The current answer failed. Send this queued message manually, edit it, or cancel it.
chat.guestPromptLimitHelper: Guest demo limits are backend-owned; queued and immediate messages still count when accepted.
chat.queuedAnnouncement: Message queued to send after the current answer.
chat.queueEditAnnouncement: Queued message moved back to the composer.
chat.queueAlreadyExistsAnnouncement: A queued message already exists. Edit or cancel it first.
chat.stoppingCurrentAnswerAnnouncement: Stopping the current answer before sending your message.
chat.currentAnswerStoppingAnnouncement: Backend accepted the stop request. Waiting for the current answer to close.
chat.immediateFailedAnnouncement: Could not stop the current answer. Your message was restored to the composer.
chat.noRunsDescription: Send a message to create the first run.
chat.noEventsDescription: Latest run events will appear here.
chat.noCitationsDescription: RAG citations appear when retrieved context is used.
chat.messageEvidenceUnavailable: Run evidence is attached to the latest assistant answer.
chat.guestNoticeDescription: This guest session lasts 24 hours and is limited to one chat, 5 prompts, and 3 document uploads. If you hit a limit, the backend will return a safe error here.
chat.knowledgeSourceDescription: Choose which knowledge bases this run may retrieve from. Selected mode is a hard boundary; All searches every authorized knowledge base.
chat.noKnowledgeBasesDescription: Create a knowledge base, add documents, then select it here.
chat.knowledgeSourceRequired: Select at least one knowledge base or switch back to All knowledge bases.
chat.replaySuccess: Regenerated. The conversation was refreshed with the backend replay result.
chat.replaySourcesUnavailable: Regenerated using current knowledge only. Some sources from the original answer are no longer available.
chat.replaySourcesUnavailableAnnouncement: Assistant message regenerated with unavailable original sources omitted.
chat.replayFailed: Could not regenerate this assistant message.
chat.replayConflict: Only the latest assistant message can be regenerated right now.
chat.replayConflictAnnouncement: This assistant message cannot be regenerated because it is not the latest replayable answer.
chat.personalChatBoundaryCopy: Personal Chat keeps the current private user-to-AI conversation flow and personal knowledge controls.
chat.groupChatBoundaryCopy: Group Chat is still private 1:1 user-to-AI. The group only provides mandatory knowledge context; it is not a member chat room and does not expose your transcript.
chat.groupKnowledgeSourceDescription: Preview the V1 group source boundary: mandatory group KB plus optional private personal KB attachment.
chat.mandatoryGroupKnowledgeDescription: {group} knowledge is fixed for group chat and cannot be disabled from the composer.
chat.groupContextRequired: Select a group to see its mandatory knowledge bases.
chat.noGroupKnowledgeBases: No group KBs for this group yet
chat.optionalPrivateKnowledgeDescription: These attachments are per-run and private to you. They never mutate group state and are not visible to other members.
chat.groupChatOpenApiPending: Backend OpenAPI is available. Group Chat sends the mandatory group KB plus only the private personal KBs you explicitly attach.
chat.groupChatSendDisabled: Choose a group context before sending Group Chat. Personal attachments stay private to this run.
chat.groupComposerPlaceholder: Group Chat preview — backend OpenAPI required before sending...
chat.groupChatCreateDisabled: Choose a group context before creating Group Chat.
chat.groupChatPendingAnnouncement: Choose a group context, then create a private group-source conversation.

common.emptyListDescription: Create one from the form above.

knowledge.title: Knowledge bases
knowledge.description: Create Personal KBs for private documents, or additional Group KBs for documents approved into a selected group. Every new group starts with one default Group KB.
knowledge.scopeHint: Personal KBs stay private to your account. Group KBs are group-owned retrieval libraries; add personal material through owner/admin-approved publish requests.
knowledge.groupHint: Required for extra Group KBs. Only groups where you are owner/admin are listed.
knowledge.groupDisabledHint: Choose group scope to select an existing group.
knowledge.noGroupsDescription: Create a group or ask a group owner/admin before creating another group knowledge base.
knowledge.scopeBoundaryNote: Boundary: new groups automatically get one Group KB. Upload documents to Personal KBs first; publishing into a Group KB requires owner/admin approval and does not publish member chat, transcripts, or private Personal KB attachments.
knowledge.listPersonalSubtitle: Personal KB · private to your account
knowledge.listGroupSubtitle: Group KB · available to selected group members

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Manage private Personal KB documents, PDF/Markdown/plain-text uploads, ingestion, extraction runs, and direct permission patches. To share with a group, submit a publish request for owner/admin approval.
documents.contentHint: The backend stores content and deterministic ingestion creates chunks/entities.
documents.permissionLabel: Grant read permission to user id
documents.permissionHint: Backend currently exposes an ID-based permission contract. User search should be a backend request if needed.
documents.pdfUploadHint: Upload a PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), or plain text (.txt) file into the selected Personal KB. CSV/JSON are not advertised until backend structural support is confirmed.
documents.deleteDescription: Remove the selected uploaded or text document when ingestion produced bad data. This cannot be undone.
documents.fileUploadHint: Upload a PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), or plain text (.txt) file into the selected Personal KB. CSV/JSON are not advertised until backend structural support is confirmed.
documents.multiFileUploadHint: Select one or more PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), or plain text (.txt) files. Each file is limited to {maxSize}.
documents.unsupportedFileError: Unsupported file type. Choose PDF, Markdown, or plain text.
documents.fileTooLargeError: File is too large. Maximum size is {maxSize}.
documents.filesAddedAnnouncement: {count} files added to the upload queue.
documents.uploadRemovedAnnouncement: File removed from the upload queue.
documents.guestUploadLimitHint: Guest demo uploads are limited by the backend; each accepted file counts toward the 3-document upload cap.
documents.knowledgeBaseHint: Create a Personal KB first. New text documents, file uploads, and ingestion runs stay private until you request publication into a group.
documents.knowledgeBaseRequired: Select a personal knowledge base before adding or ingesting documents.
documents.noKnowledgeBaseDescription: Go to Knowledge and create a Personal KB before uploading documents. Group KBs receive documents only through approved publish requests.
documents.knowledgeBaseLockedHint: Finish or remove queued uploads before switching personal knowledge bases so each file stays attached to the intended private library.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Create/list groups and manage member roles through the backend ID-based membership routes.
groups.noSelectedDescription: Create or select a group first.
groups.membershipManagerOnlyHint: Only group owners and admins can add members or change roles.
groups.backendNote: Backend currently exposes ID-based member operations. If user search or member listing is needed, add a backend request before changing ../my-agents.
groups.publishBoundaryDescription: Members can publish an entire Personal KB as a mandatory group source, or request a document copy into a Group KB. Owner/admin approval is required before either affects group retrieval.
groups.publishSourceDocumentHint: Use this for a one-document copy into a selected Group KB.
groups.publishTargetKnowledgeBaseHint: Only document-copy requests need a target Group KB. Whole-KB requests attach to the group itself.
groups.publishReviewHint: Owner/admin-only approval or rejection; no auto-publish.
groups.publishOpenApiNote: Publish requests now support both whole Personal KB approval and single-document copy approval. Pending or rejected requests do not change group retrieval.
groups.publishSourceKnowledgeBaseHint: Approval shares this whole Personal KB with the group. Future documents in that KB become group sources after ingestion.
